## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and any relevant context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing performed
- [ ] All existing tests pass

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] `cargo fmt` has been run
- [ ] `cargo clippy` passes with no warnings
- [ ] No new compiler warnings introduced
- [ ] Dependencies are security-reviewed (no vulnerable crates)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, tokens, or sensitive data
- [ ] No real infrastructure addresses or credentials
- [ ] Documentation is updated as needed
- [ ] Changelog is updated (if applicable)
